meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 安装 Resend 邮件渠道：复制适配器、注册、装依赖、构建验证，然后将你的邮箱设为所有者并发一封测试邮件。之后你就能通过电子邮件与机器人对话。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Resend 邮件渠道、接入邮件收发，或在 /setup 流程中需要配置邮件时。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件渠道。
say.note: 开始执行整个添加流程。

say.text: 把 Resend 的 API key 和发件地址存到 .env。
say.note: 会提示你输入密钥等信息。

say.text: 用 you@example.com 作为所有者邮箱。
say.note: 会设置该地址并发送测试邮件。

howto.what_en: Adds a Resend email channel to NanoClaw: copies/registers the adapter, installs the pinned package, builds, prompts for credentials into .env, wires your email as owner and sends a hello email. You can then chat by email.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add the Resend email channel, set up email messaging, or configure email during the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw.
Save the Resend API key and from-address to .env.
Set you@example.com as the owner email.
say_en.note: Wires that address and sends a test email.
